newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rothmans lights up on profit, special div.
newsitem.headline: Rothmans lights up on profit, special div.

text.p: Shares in cigarette manufacturer Rothmans Ltd jumped 60 cents or 6.7 percent to A$8.90 in late Wednesday trade after it announced a doubling of annual profits and posted a A$1.00 per share special dividend.
Volumes at over 220,000 were active for what is usually a lightly traded stock.

Rothmans Ltd is a cigarette manufacturer and is about 50 percent owned by Rothmans International Ltd which in turn is owned 60 percent by Swiss firm Richemont AG and 40 percent by South African group Rembrandt Group Ltd.
The special dividend came from the repatriation of retained earnings from Rothman's New Zealand operations, the company said.
